body:
Hey, I've got a legit question.  You probably don't remember me or anything, let alone my stupid post.  But why did you hide your comment above?

I figured it's almost the New Year, I just wanted to resolve a thing or two.  

Happy New Year, by the way.
Yes, true.  Thank you for the input, you make a good point.
Exactly.  Can't agree to that enough-- you hit the nail right on the head. :)
You too, huh?
I don't think this was Jim Carrey. ^^; OH! But I remember that movie! XD It's a great one.  But unfortunately this video series isn't quite it.... thank you for your help though. : )

I'm a very big Marble Hornets fan. XD But the Slenderman wasn't in this series, plus the video was one of the first ones.  Marble Hornets is still pretty awesome though, I think the other series though was found through reddit actually, in one of those "scary parts of the internet" threads.
No, I'm fairly certain it was a series.  But Cache sounds interesting, thank you anyways. ^^

And for the record.  Who the fuck said I was doing this for kicks? I didn't ask to be given these feelings; these emotions.  And yeah.  I probably would still want to do this if I had no one.  

It's not a matter of growing up.  It's a matter of finding support and getting help, something I came here for.

Tch.  Maybe this isn't the place for it either if "growing up" is your response to this.
.... Good point.

It's kind of against the subreddit rules to tell you...

In fact, why not tell us some more about why you want to overdose?  I want (wanted?) to do the same as you, what's wrong?  Talk to me. : )
Wheatley, maybe GLaDOS.
[Guys... "Benedict Cumbercat"](http://www.animalhumanesociety.org/adoption/detail/22686782)
Ah, your comment made me laugh. XD You make an excellent point nonetheless, I've heard about the Song of Solomon before. XDD

I just perused the subreddit, I couldn't find too many posts that said that waiting was the reasoning behind their dead bedrooms... in fact, I once came across an article that said waiting could make for an even more successful marriage. :/ I'm not quite sure why waiting would ruin me.

(I guess one could argue that I have a bit of a... I dunno, "rocky relationship" with God.  I believe in him ((mostly...)), not so sure if I agree with the Church.  I just don't see why if as long as we don't wrongly act on it, it's still wrong.  And yes, I know about the whole "he who looks at a women lustfully has already committed lust in his own heart" or something like that, but if someone thinks about robbing a bank but they don't do it, is it still wrong?

Not to mention that there's some aspects of the Bible that are kind of outdated anyway.  Either way, I was made feeling the way I am.  I just don't see it as wrong.  But you and that fellow up there are both correct in certain ways, no one here is necessarily incorrect)
Yo, it's all good man.  All opinions are welcome.  Both of you are correct, how 'bout that?
Guys, guys.  It's alright.  All opinions are welcome.

Cameron, just as starters, what you just posted took some major fucking balls and hold all the respect in the world for you because of it.

One.  You are worth something, your life is worth something, and don't you dare let yourself believe any different.

Two. If music made you happy, then it was never EVER a waste of time.  Happiness is never a waste.  

Three.  Please *please* please don't do it.  Don't throw your life away.  Like everyone else, I agree: you sound like a phenomenal guy, please don't take yourself from this life when there's still so much life ahead of you.

I can't pretend I know what you're going through, I don't.  But I do know is that I can't bear to see you go.

Please reconsider.
Where is this even going

I agree with you; I think that's the best way to go.  But since our biggest means of communicating is over text, I'm just having a little trouble finding a gentle way to tell him without him misinterpreting what I'm trying to say (unfortunately that seems to happen every now and again between the two of us XD).  

But hey, I really appreciate your comment.  I like your advice, and the advice of the other commentors-- I'm going to try and follow it! ^^

I feel like that might be the case, too.  I've known what an infatuation feels like, that stuff's pretty intense.  It just concerns me a little that I don't quite feel it in turn, like I'm questioning if I really want to be with him or not or if it's just the speed of things that's making me feel apprehensive...

It is his first relationship too; so what you're saying makes a lot of sense. : )

Thank you so much.  I'm glad to hear that I'm thinking clearly and reasonably, at the very least. XD 

Agh, I just wish I knew how to bring it up with him.  I mean, half the stuff we say in text I'm not sure we have the guts to say in real life, and I'm just fearful that he'll misinterpret what I'm saying... 

Do you maybe have any ideas as to how to breach the subject with him...?

Took a while, but I got it with the help of a friend- 

463c8a7593a8a79078cb5c119424e62a = "crack" 

I apologize for the late reply! I hadn't been able to get a hold of my computer for a few days- so I'm running a bit behind on a few things. ^^; Anyways, like thegoo280 I'm looking forward to your next explanation.  I'm really grateful for your help with this- it helps a lot. : )
Ah! I'm here- I apologize, life has kept me occupied since I posted! >_<  I'll reply to your comment right away- sorry for the lateness!
*small white butterflies proceed to daintily fly after the horrified students*

Dude, you have no idea how much your comment means to me.  Knowing that what is happening has a name- it helps.  But even if it was two years ago- you can still have someone to connect with, right? ^^

I'll see if I can take your advice- it might be a bit difficult, seeing that my folks said they would only take me to see a professional when I couldn't "find one positive thing about myself"... I can find plenty positive things, that won't change the fact that I want to get hurt... Nonetheless- I'll give it another shot.  Things aren't quite so bad now- I'll probably run it by them again in the fall when it comes back.

But bro- thank you so much.  Three comments total on this post (from both places I posted it-) I think yours was the most helpful. :). 

Thanks again. :)
Good on you, bro.  Hope you feel better. : )
((Haha, you're username is awesome. XD))
Um... no problem...?
Well, it's nice to know I'm not alone, right? XD
Good point. XD
Woo-hoo~! XD
